It then processes disjoint64-output batches, retaining original global weight rows and the unchanged staged2 four-lane K16 recurrence. A two-CTA variant partitions batches by parity. decision.decision: Keep isolated. Complete input-row reuse preserves every original K16 state and captured GB10 endpoint, but two-CTA QKV differs from current by only-0.0938ms and OUT by-7.93ms. One-CTA QKV regresses slightly. These component observations do not establish a seconds-scale product gain; the retained full-attention OUT also uses a different coarse owner. Static50-VGPR declarations and fewer logical global input reads are not measured occupancy or bandwidth evidence. Continue a broader reduction of exact arithmetic instead of integrating this schedule.
